profile.headline: The last web development partner you’ll need | Founder & Principal Software Engineer @ 84EM | Websites, apps, and AI integrations, built and supported for the long haul.
profile.summary:
Building for the web since 1995. Clients stay for years. Some, for decades.

I run 84EM LLC, a software engineering and consulting practice in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. I work with digital agencies, white-label or introduced to the client as their vendor, and directly with businesses that need senior engineering help. You deal with one person, and it's the person writing the code.
 
I'm platform-agnostic and work in whatever the project needs: PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, Python, React, Next.js, Shopify, Squarespace -- just about anything.

Clients bring me in for:

- AI integrations. Custom tools built on the Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini APIs.

- Complex builds. Deep API integrations, custom plugin development, headless architectures.

- Security and performance audits. Finding what's broken before it breaks in front of customers.

- Consulting. Architecture planning, vendor evaluation, team mentoring, second opinions.

A good chunk of my work now is finishing what someone else started. The previous vendor vanished, the build stalled, or an AI prototype demos fine and fails in production. I'll take it on regardless of platform or what shape the codebase is in. It starts with an audit, then stabilizing enough to launch.

If your agency needs a development partner, or you've got a technical problem that's been sitting too long, message me here or reach out through 84em.com.

(84EM doesn't outsource development and doesn't work with recruiters. Those messages get ignored.)
